Partial started state without complete checkpoint fails closed; reload every old/final row exactly. Fresh teacher reload and separate student initialization preserve original RNG.

suffix: N_raw = retained M + new tabm_direct - retained direct_control

secondary_gate.scope: After all six immutable model fits and the primary scorer/audit, assemble all three new CV direct vectors and the same retained v82 suffix, using all344419 original Jan/Jul IDs and held truth only at scoring. No new fits, inference, calibration or source-posterior evaluation.
secondary_gate.reference: Retained portable_public_source/cv/stages.parquet submitted; baseline zero replay exact.
secondary_gate.criterion: Primary exact-v80 gate PASS AND target_consistency has lower serialized mean Jan/Jul RMSE than retained v82, each month strictly improves, and paired-day bootstrap95% upper<0 versus v82. No additional minimum effect threshold on v82; no alternative arm selected.
secondary_gate.bootstrap: Same tuning_seasonal.paired_bootstrap defaults reps2000/seed0 and same month/day blocks as primary; compare target and v82 squared errors. Report all three arms and descriptive target-control differences, but never promote controls or tune blends.
secondary_gate.failure: If secondary fails, do not route continuation into v82 final; report portability failure. Primary may still support an old-ranking v80 candidate, subject to root decision and slot policy. Do not alter the fixed production target pool to salvage portability.
secondary_gate.interpretation: Reused transductive development gate, not independent confirmation; final target mix contains additionalFeb/Jun months and shifted inputs.
